home.title: A complete .NET development experience.
home.lede: SharpLsp is the open-source alternative to Visual Studio, Rider, and C# Dev Kit — language intelligence, solution tooling, refactoring, NuGet, debugging, and profiling for C# and F# without subscriptions or vendor lock-in.
home.engines: C# via Roslyn. F# via FSharp.Compiler.Service.
home.screenshotAlt: SharpLsp running a full .NET solution in VS Code with C# navigation, solution explorer, and a graphical NuGet package manager
home.screenshotCaption: A real .NET workspace powered by SharpLsp — solution explorer, code intelligence, NuGet, debugging, and profiling included.
home.workflowTitle: One Dev Experience. Everything you need to ship .NET.
home.workflowIntro: SharpLsp goes beyond autocomplete. It brings the connected, project-aware experience developers expect from a full IDE to the editor they already use.

workflows.title: Write & navigate
workflows.description: Fast, solution-wide language intelligence that understands real C# and F# projects.

workflows.description: Stay in one workspace from dependency management to the final performance pass.

home.languageTitle: C# and F#. No second-class language.
home.languageIntro: Each language gets its native compiler services and the same commitment to a complete development workflow.

languages.name: C#

languages.name: F#

home.alternativeTitle: The open-source alternative to Visual Studio, Rider, and C# Dev Kit.
home.alternativeIntro: Keep the depth of a .NET IDE without giving up your editor, your platform, or control of your development environment.

reasons.title: Editor-independent
reasons.description: Use VS Code, Zed, or any standards-based editor instead of rebuilding your workflow around one IDE.

reasons.title: No proprietary core
reasons.description: Open implementations, open protocols, and source you can inspect from end to end.

reasons.title: No subscription
reasons.description: MIT licensed for personal, commercial, and organizational use.

reasons.title: Cross-platform
reasons.description: The same C# and F# development experience on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

home.title: 完整的 .NET 开发体验。
home.lede: SharpLsp 是 Visual Studio、Rider 和 C# Dev Kit 的开源替代方案，为 C# 与 F# 提供语言智能、解决方案工具、重构、NuGet、调试和性能分析，无需订阅，也没有厂商锁定。
